headline: NXP lists an AI-agent internship for migrating behavioral models and generating validation testbenches
fact: NXP posted Toulouse internship R-10066989 on September 23 to prototype AI-agent migration of legacy behavioral models and generate stimuli/testbenches for mixed-signal validation; its skills include Verilog/SystemVerilog and Verilog-AMS. Related R-10067009, posted October 5, concerns AI-assisted generation and maintenance of HDL AMS models, with a Golden Library covering oscillators, ADCs and supply blocks and Verilog-A/AMS/SystemVerilog skills. These related model-development postings are grouped as advertised research work, not evidence of completed AI deployment.
